messages:
tara: Kickoff: Lacuna wants a short perf check to validate burst recovery and get a per-10k-token cost. They need a clear run matrix + security callouts for BYOK. Can we assemble run + cost sketch by Fri? :spiral_calendar:

micah: Proposed short matrix: 1) Warm/ramp: 2k qps -> hold 30m. 2) Spike: 10k qps for 10s x5 spaced 60s. 3) Failover: during 2 spikes route 30% to smaller model. Capture p50/p95/p99 token latency, enqueue_wait_ms, avg_batch, and error-rate.

ron: Ops checklist: warm caches 15m; continuous batching on; max_batch_ms=12; set `--warmup 15m`. Pin model shards on Dedicated. Tag runs `lacuna-poc`. If queue wait > 40ms, trigger graceful route to fallback.

micah: Smoke commands (adapt to your tool):
```
# mixed workload smoke
python tools/loadgen.py --mix "short:70,long:30" --prompt-len 35 --resp-len 60 --qps 2000 --duration 30m --warmup 15m --tag lacuna-poc
# spike pattern
python tools/loadgen.py --burst-qps 10000 --burst-duration 10 --bursts 5 --spacing 60 --out results/spike.json
```

june-cust: Quick Q: our UI does thin-client bursts (~30 tokens prompts) and some tool-call round-trips. Can you include tool-call overhead? Also need audit logs for the run.

sec-bot: Sec questionnaire link uploaded: https://redwood-internal/sq/1602. POC asks for IP allowlist + BYOK option. Audit logs available per-run.

ron: KMS note: per-request KMS adds ~6-10ms if called each time. For POC enable host-side derived-key cache (TTL 30s) to avoid per-request KMS latency. We'll document the cache tradeoffs in answers.

micah: Ballpark cost for this mix from recent runs: hosted ~ $0.027 per 10k tokens under bursty traffic; Dedicated reserved ~ $0.014 per 10k tokens if baseline capacity reserved. We'll include burst-minute surcharge estimate if they expect heavy spike minutes.

ops-bot: Reservation created dh-res-80123 for Fri 2027-04-09T10:00Z, pool=dedicated-standard-6.

tara: Next steps: Micah to post final runbook + cost calc by Thu EOD. Ron to prepare caching + warmup config. June, please confirm whether BYOK will be used for POC or if Lacuna prefers Redwood-managed keys. Test window Fri 10:00Z. Tag blockers here. :white_check_mark:
